## Names

<a id="tbc_joystick"></a>
### [`tbc_joystick`](../../../../src/crack/tbc_joystick.asm#L6) `$4800`

*routine*

TBC crack: joystick routine. The TBC loader KP calls it from the IRQ in joystick mode (JSR $4800 at $09fc). It moves the cursor with joystick port 1.

- **Reads:** [`CIAPRB`](../../memory-map.md#CIAPRB)
- **Writes:** [`pad_y_raw`](../../memory-map.md#pad_y_raw), [`pad_x_raw`](../../memory-map.md#pad_x_raw)
